_about: Inspectable objects in the developed rooms. shipRecord is neutral visitor-facing description derived from the cited plan or log; quotes reference public/data/observations.json. Character-voice drafts live separately in data/drafts/perspective-lines.draft.json.

items.label: Helm and pilot cradle
items.shipRecord: Pilot cradle and helm console on the bridge centreline, facing the forward glass. The helm’s kneehole panel stands open; an older, unmapped harness runs beneath it.
items.basis: Roomwright layout v34 (helmConsole, pilotCradle, helm kneehole panel)

items.label: Forward glass
items.shipRecord: Real glass, not a display: a 4.8 m viewport band with its sill at 0.55 m.
items.basis: Roomwright layout v34 (viewportWall); production plan V1

items.label: Nav lock levers
items.shipRecord: Physical course-hold levers at the pilot’s right hand. Author ruling: Presence-02’s “nav locks” are helm hardware, not the lower-deck nav compartment.

items.label: Copilot chair
items.shipRecord: Second seat, starboard of the helm. A short station rail stands between the stations with the chair gap left open.
items.basis: Roomwright layout v34; author ruling on the rail-between-stations conflict

items.label: Auxiliary console
items.shipRecord: Auxiliary station to port, angled toward the helm, with an occupancy strip along its edge.

items.label: Loose bolts on the deck
items.shipRecord: Stripped bolts and washers on the open deck behind the seats. Production-flexible: they move.
items.basis: Roomwright layout v34 (bolts); production plan V1 flexible elements

items.label: Forward rail
items.shipRecord: Worn rail across the forward stations, with a row of indicator lights.

items.label: Viewport bench
items.shipRecord: A bench built into the forward viewport, port side.

items.label: The corridor elbow
items.shipRecord: The primary corridor offsets here, before the medbay, so nobody boarding through the airlock looks straight into medical. The storage-spine hatch is the turn just forward of it.
items.basis: Design decisions log (main-deck topology); Roomwright layout v34

items.label: Corridor service panel
items.shipRecord: Power-distribution pull panel on the forward run. Maintenance aboard happens in lived space, wherever the runs go.

items.label: Counter run and sink
items.shipRecord: One long integrated counter run with the sink, along the port side. The prose’s “central prep counter” is the working stretch of this run, not a free-standing island (author ruling).
items.basis: Comic Production Floor Plan V1 — galley fixed background elements

items.label: Tin shelf
items.shipRecord: Tin shelf above the working side, with a warm strip light under it.

items.label: Heating and hydration unit
items.shipRecord: Heating / hydration appliance on the side opposite the counter. Its service panel opens from the same wall.
items.basis: Comic Production Floor Plan V1; exact technology still open in the design log

items.label: Cooling unit
items.shipRecord: Cooling unit, low in the aft half.

items.label: Galley table
items.shipRecord: A real table in the aft, eating-and-lingering half. Stools move; the table does not.

items.label: Leather bench
items.shipRecord: Leather-covered bench against the aft wall.

items.label: Cabinet
items.shipRecord: The cabinet with the bolts-in-a-mug. A drawer below holds two spoons.

items.label: Corner fan
items.shipRecord: Corner fan, forward port corner of the galley.
